# C5: AI runtime

Agents are defined as data: what they read, what they may write, the model and budget. Every run gets a context pack (the data it may see, wrapped and labelled as data, never instructions, with its classification), and leaves a run summary. Recordings let any run be replayed without a model, which is how tests run.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version        | Value |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Schema version | 1     |
